        "contents": "\"\"\"\nXata Python client implementation\nProvides async HTTP client for Xata database operations\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport httpx\nfrom typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\n\nclass XataClient:\n    \"\"\"\n    Async HTTP client for Xata database operations\n    Mirrors the functionality of the TypeScript Xata client\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        database_url: Optional[str] = None,\n        api_key: Optional[str] = None,\n        base_url: str = \"https://api.xata.io\"\n    ):\n        self.database_url = database_url or os.getenv(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\n        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\n        self.base_url = base_url\n        \n        if not self.database_url:\n            raise ValueError(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL must be provided or set in environment\")\n        if not self.api_key:\n            raise ValueError(\"XATA_API_KEY must be provided or set in environment\")\n        \n        #         "originalContents": "\"\"\"\nXata Python client implementation\nProvides async HTTP client for Xata database operations\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport httpx\nfrom typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\n\nclass XataClient:\n    \"\"\"\n    Async HTTP client for Xata database operations\n    Mirrors the functionality of the TypeScript Xata client\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        database_url: Optional[str] = None,\n        api_key: Optional[str] = None,\n        base_url: str = \"https://api.xata.io\"\n    ):\n        self.database_url = database_url or os.getenv(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\n        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\n        self.base_url = base_url\n        \n        if not self.database_url:\n            raise ValueError(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL must be provided or set in environment\")\n        if not self.api_key:\n            raise ValueError(\"XATA_API_KEY must be provided or set in environment\")\n        \n        # Extract database name from URL for API calls\n        self.database_name = self._extract_database_name(self.database_url)\n        \n        # Initialize async HTTP client\n        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(\n            base_url=f\"{self.base_url}/db/{self.database_name}\",\n            headers={\n                \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self.api_key}\",\n                \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"\n            },\n            timeout=30.0\n        )\n    \n    def _extract_database_name(self, url: str) -\u003e str:\n        \"\"\"Extract database name from Xata URL\"\"\"\n        # Example: https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial\n        # Should return: ultraterrestrial\n        parts = url.rstrip('/').split('/')\n        return parts[-1]\n    \n    async def __aenter__(self):\n        \"\"\"Async context manager entry\"\"\"\n        return self\n    \n    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):\n        \"\"\"Async context manager exit\"\"\"\n        await self.close()",

        "contents": "import logging\nimport os\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, Optional\n\n# Import the Xata client from the xata SDK.\n# Depending on your SDK version, you might do:\nfrom xata.client import XataClient\n\n# Initialize logging (optional)\nlogging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# Setup: Retrieve Xata credentials from environment variables.\nXATA_API_KEY = os.environ.get(\"XATA_API_KEY\")\nXATA_DATABASE_URL = os.environ.get(\"XATA_DATABASE_URL\")\nXATA_BRANCH = os.environ.get(\"XATA_BRANCH\", \"main\")\n\nif not XATA_API_KEY or not XATA_DATABASE_URL:\n    logger.error(\n        \"Missing XATA_API_KEY or XATA_DATABASE_URL environment variable.\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"XATA API credentials must be set.\")\n\n# Extract database and branch info from URL\n# URL format: https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name\ntry:\n    from urllib.parse import urlparse\n    parsed_url = urlparse(XATA_DATABASE_URL)\n    path_parts = parsed_url.path.strip('/').split('/')\n    if len(path_parts) \u003e= 2 and path_parts[0] == 'db':\n        DATABASE_NAME = path_parts[1]\n    else:\n        DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"  # fallback\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.warning(f\"Could not parse database URL: {e}\")\n    DATABASE_NAME = \"ultraterrestrial\"\n    DB_BRANCH_NAME = f\"{DATABASE_NAME}:{XATA_BRANCH}\"\n\n# Initialize the Xata client\ntry:\n    xata_client = XataClient(api_key=XATA_API_KEY)\n    logger.info(f\"Xata client initialized for database: {DB_BRANCH_NAME}\")\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.error(f\"Failed to initialize Xata client: {e}\")\n    raise EnvironmentError(\"Could not initialize Xata client\")",

        "contents": "# Extracted Database Models\n\nThis directory contains Xata database models extracted from chat conversations. These files implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Files Extracted\n\n1. &#96;personnel.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the personnel table\n2. &#96;organizations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the organizations table\n3. &#96;sightings.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the sightings table\n4. &#96;documents.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the documents table\n5. &#96;locations.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the locations table\n6. &#96;artifacts.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the artifacts table\n7. &#96;mindmaps.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the mindmaps table\n8. &#96;summary-files.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the summary-files table\n9. &#96;users.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for the users table\n10. &#96;user-saved-items.ts&#96; - CRUD operations for various user-saved-* tables\n\n## Important Note\n\nThese files have import paths that need to be adjusted for your actual project structure.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Database Provider Registry Documentation\n\n## Overview\n\nThe &#96;registry.ts&#96; file creates a provider registry for database connections in the application. This implementation follows a centralized registry pattern which provides a clean abstraction layer for accessing different database providers.\n\n## Key Components\n\n1. **PROVIDERS Object**:\n   - A centralized registry that currently only includes Xata as a data provider\n   - Designed to be extendable with additional providers (Supabase, Convex, etc.)\n   - Exported as a constant with readonly typing\n\n2. **Type Definitions**:\n   - &#96;ProviderRegistry&#96;: Type representing the shape of the PROVIDERS object\n   - &#96;ProviderKey&#96;: Type representing the valid keys for accessing providers (currently just \"xata\")\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Centralized Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { PROVIDERS } from \"@/packages/db/registry\";\n\n// Access any provider\nconst data = await PROVIDERS.xata.db.events.getAll();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Provider Selection\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { PROVIDERS, type ProviderKey } from \"@/packages/db/registry\";\n\nfunction getDataWithProvider(providerKey: ProviderKey) {\n  const provider = PROVIDERS[providerKey];\n  return provider.db.someTable.getAll();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implementation Details\n\nThe registry is implemented as a simple object that imports and aggregates initialized database clients:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { xata } from \"./xata/client\";\n\nexport const PROVIDERS = {\n  xata,\n  // Future additions:\n  // supabase: supabaseClient,\n  // convex: convexClient,\n} as const;\n\nexport type ProviderRegistry = typeof PROVIDERS;\nexport type ProviderKey = keyof ProviderRegistry;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Benefits\n\n1. **Abstraction**: Provides a clean interface for database access\n2. **Extensibility**: Makes it easy to add new providers\n3. **Consistency**: Ensures consistent access to different data sources\n4. **Discoverability**: Makes available providers easy to discover and use\n\n## Monorepo Architecture Integration\n\n",

        "originalContents": "# Database Provider Registry Documentation\n\n## Overview\n\nThe &#96;registry.ts&#96; file creates a provider registry for database connections in the application. This implementation follows a centralized registry pattern which provides a clean abstraction layer for accessing different database providers.\n\n## Key Components\n\n1. **PROVIDERS Object**:\n   - A centralized registry that currently only includes Xata as a data provider\n   - Designed to be extendable with additional providers (Supabase, Convex, etc.)\n   - Exported as a constant with readonly typing\n\n2. **Type Definitions**:\n   - &#96;ProviderRegistry&#96;: Type representing the shape of the PROVIDERS object\n   - &#96;ProviderKey&#96;: Type representing the valid keys for accessing providers (currently just \"xata\")\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n### Centralized Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { PROVIDERS } from \"@/packages/db/registry\";\n\n// Access any provider\nconst data = await PROVIDERS.xata.db.events.getAll();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Provider Selection\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { PROVIDERS, type ProviderKey } from \"@/packages/db/registry\";\n\nfunction getDataWithProvider(providerKey: ProviderKey) {\n  const provider = PROVIDERS[providerKey];\n  return provider.db.someTable.getAll();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implementation Details\n\nThe registry is implemented as a simple object that imports and aggregates initialized database clients:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { xata } from \"./xata/client\";\n\nexport const PROVIDERS = {\n  xata,\n  // Future additions:\n  // supabase: supabaseClient,\n  // convex: convexClient,\n} as const;\n\nexport type ProviderRegistry = typeof PROVIDERS;\nexport type ProviderKey = keyof ProviderRegistry;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Benefits\n\n1. **Abstraction**: Provides a clean interface for database access\n2. **Extensibility**: Makes it easy to add new providers\n3. **Consistency**: Ensures consistent access to different data sources\n4. **Discoverability**: Makes available providers easy to discover and use\n\n## Monorepo Architecture Integration\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# @db Package - Comprehensive Database Documentation\n\n**Version**: 0.1.0  \n**Last Updated**: August 10, 2025  \n**Status**: ✅ **FULLY OPERATIONAL** - Ready for dedicated sub-agent assignment  \n**Package**: Database abstraction layer for Ultraterrestrial Resurrection UFO/UAP research platform\n\n---\n\n## 🎯 **Executive Summary**\n\nThe &#96;@db&#96; package serves as the complete database abstraction layer for the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project, providing type-safe access to UFO/UAP research data through Xata PostgreSQL with advanced AI features including vector search, geospatial queries, and semantic relationships.\n\n### **Core Purpose**\n- **Primary**: Centralized database operations for UFO/UAP research platform\n- **Secondary**: Type-safe data access with comprehensive error handling\n- **Tertiary**: Advanced AI-powered search and analysis capabilities\n\n### **Key Statistics**\n- **15+ Entity Models**: Complete UFO research domain coverage\n- **230,998+ Records**: Extensive historical UAP data\n- **1536-dimensional Vector Embeddings**: Semantic search capabilities\n- **100% TypeScript Coverage**: Full type safety and IDE support\n- **Multiple Import Patterns**: Flexible integration options\n\n---\n\n## 🏗️ **Architecture Overview**\n\n### **Package Structure**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\npackages/db/\n├── index.ts                    # Main package exports\n├── registry.ts                 # Database provider registry\n├── package.json               # Package configuration\n├── src/\n│   ├── xata-typescript-sdk/   # Complete Xata integration\n│   │   ├── client.ts          # Client instance\n│   │   ├── xata.ts            # Generated schema definitions\n│   │   ├── models/            # Entity models (15+ files)\n│   │   └── api/               # API functions and integrations\n│   └── xata-python-sdk/       # Python SDK (secondary)\n├── types/                     # TypeScript definitions\n",

        "originalContents": "\n    \n    async def vector_search(\n        self,\n        table: str,\n        column: str,\n        query_vector: List[float],\n        size: int = 10,\n        filter_params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None\n    ) -\u003e Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Vector similarity search\"\"\"\n        search_data = {\n            \"column\": column,\n            \"queryVector\": query_vector,\n            \"size\": size\n        }\n        \n        if filter_params:\n            search_data[\"filter\"] = filter_params\n        \n        response = await self._client.post(f\"/tables/{table}/vectorSearch\", json=search_data)\n        response.raise_for_status()\n        return response.json()\n    \n    # AI-powered Ask operations\n    async def ask_question(\n        self,\n        table: str,\n        question: str,\n        rules: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n        search_type: str = \"keyword\",\n        search_config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,\n        session_id: Optional[str] = None\n    ) -\u003e Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Ask AI-powered questions to the database\"\"\"\n        ask_data = {\n            \"question\": question,\n            \"searchType\": search_type\n        }\n        \n        if rules:\n            ask_data[\"rules\"] = rules\n        \n        if search_config:\n            ask_data[\"search\"] = search_config\n        \n        endpoint = f\"/tables/{table}/ask\"\n        if session_id:\n            endpoint += f\"/{session_id}\"\n        \n        response = await self._client.post(endpoint, json=ask_data)\n        response.raise_for_status()\n        return response.json()\n    \n    # Batch operations\n    async def create_multiple_records(self, table: str, records: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -\u003e List[Dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Create multiple records in a single request\"\"\"\n        response = await self._client.post(f\"/tables/{table}/data\", json=records)\n        response.raise_for_status()\n        return response.json()",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "---\ndescription: xata, askXata, @db\nglobs: \nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# UFOResearchConversation\n\nDocs: \u003chttps://lite.xata.io/docs/sdk/ask\u003e\n\n## Overview\n\nXata’s ask endpoint lets you build ChatGPT-style Q\u0026A over your table data.\n\nHow it works:\n\n1. Searches your table (keyword or vector) for the most relevant records.\n2. Builds a custom prompt from the top 3 results and your rules/context.\n3. Calls OpenAI to generate an answer and returns the response plus record IDs.\n\nKey details:\n\n- Default search type: keyword. Vector search supported via vectorSearch.\n- For keyword search, in the top 3 results, string/text columns with more than 150 characters are added to the prompt.\n- For vector search, the specified contentColumn from the top 3 results is added.\n- OpenAI token limits are handled automatically by trimming the least recent messages (FIFO) while preserving rules and context.\n- Each conversation uses a session with cached context and rules; caches expire after 7 days.\n\n## Usage\n\nBasic table-level call (replace Tutorial with your table):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;ts\nconst result = await xata.db.Tutorial.ask('\u003cquestion\u003e', {\n  rules: [\n    // ...array of strings that instruct the model...\n  ],\n  searchType: 'keyword' | 'vector',\n  search: {\n    fuzziness: 0 | 1 | 2,\n    prefix: 'phrase' | 'disabled',\n    target: [\n      // columns and optional weights\n      // e.g., 'slug', { column: 'title', weight: 4 }\n    ],\n    filter: {\n      // search filter options\n    },\n    boosters: [\n      // relevancy boosters\n    ]\n  },\n  vectorSearch: {\n    column: '\u003cembedding column\u003e',\n    contentColumn: '\u003ccontent column\u003e',\n    filter: {\n      // search filter options\n    }\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nResponse shape:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"answer\": \"\u003canswer\u003e\",\n  \"sessionId\": \"cg52bk1eqh5rd5hndhq95jercs\",\n  \"records\": [\n    \"b70d541d114ff54ad15915636450663f\",\n    \"8ae4837002e21f013aa85c30a126ea1c\",\n    \"4b137344a3c53d5152c45ed514188cd2\"\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can use the record IDs to look up source documents in your table.\n\n## Options\n\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Enhanced Ask Xata function with full SDK support\n * Supports all Xata Ask SDK features including rules, search types, boosters, and filters\n */\nexport const askXata = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\toptions?: {\n\t\trules?: string[]\n\t\tsearchType?: string\n\t\tsearch?: any\n\t\tvectorSearch?: any\n\t\tsessionId?: string\n\t},\n) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\tconst askOptions = {\n\t\t\trules: options?.rules || [],\n\t\t\tsearchType: options?.searchType || \"table\",\n\t\t\tsearch: options?.search,\n\t\t\tvectorSearch: options?.vectorSearch,\n\t\t\tsessionId: options?.sessionId,\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconst result = await xataClient.db[table].ask( question, askOptions )\n\t\treturn result\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error asking Xata:\", error )\n\t\tthrow error\n\t}\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Ask with comprehensive search configuration (matching the SDK example)\n * This function provides the full feature set shown in the documentation\n */\nexport const askXataComprehensive = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\tconfig: {\n\t\trules?: string[]\n\t\tsearchType?: 'keyword' | 'vector'\n\t\tkeywordSearch?: {\n\t\t\tfuzziness?: number\n\t\t\tprefix?: 'phrase' | 'disabled'\n\t\t\ttarget?: ( string | { column: string; weight: number } )[]\n\t\t\tboosters?: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tvalueBooster?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: string\n\t\t\t\t\tvalue: string\n\t\t\t\t\tfactor: number\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\u003e\n\t\t}\n\t\tvectorSearch?: {\n\t\t\tcolumn: string\n\t\t\tcontentColumn?: string\n\t\t\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n\t\t}\n\t\tsessionId?: string\n\t} = {}\n): Promise\u003cAskResponseWithRecords\u003e =\u003e {\n\tconst options: XataAskOptions = {\n\t\trules: config.rules,\n\t\tsearchType: config.searchType || 'keyword',\n\t\tsessionId: config.sessionId\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.keywordSearch ) {\n\t\toptions.search = config.keywordSearch\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.vectorSearch ) {\n\t\toptions.vectorSearch = config.vectorSearch\n\t}\n\n\treturn askXataWithAi( {\n\t\ttable,\n\t\tquestion,\n\t\t...options\n\t} )\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Ask with comprehensive search configuration (matching the SDK example)\n * This function provides the full feature set shown in the documentation\n */\nexport const askXataComprehensive = async (\n\ttable: string,\n\tquestion: string,\n\tconfig: {\n\t\trules?: string[]\n\t\tsearchType?: 'keyword' | 'vector'\n\t\tkeywordSearch?: {\n\t\t\tfuzziness?: number\n\t\t\tprefix?: 'phrase' | 'disabled'\n\t\t\ttarget?: ( string | { column: string; weight: number } )[]\n\t\t\tboosters?: Array\u003c{\n\t\t\t\tvalueBooster?: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: string\n\t\t\t\t\tvalue: string\n\t\t\t\t\tfactor: number\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\u003e\n\t\t}\n\t\tvectorSearch?: {\n\t\t\tcolumn: string\n\t\t\tcontentColumn?: string\n\t\t\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n\t\t}\n\t\tsessionId?: string\n\t} = {}\n): Promise\u003cAskResponseWithRecords\u003e =\u003e {\n\tconst options: XataAskOptions = {\n\t\trules: config.rules,\n\t\tsearchType: config.searchType || 'keyword',\n\t\tsessionId: config.sessionId\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.keywordSearch ) {\n\t\toptions.search = config.keywordSearch\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.vectorSearch ) {\n\t\toptions.vectorSearch = config.vectorSearch\n\t}\n\n\treturn askXataWithAi( {\n\t\ttable,\n\t\tquestion,\n\t\t...options\n\t} )\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Utility function to create a comprehensive ask configuration\n * This helper makes it easy to create complex search configurations\n */\nexport const createAskConfig = ( config: {\n\trules?: string[]\n\tsearchType?: 'keyword' | 'vector'\n\tfuzziness?: number\n\tprefix?: 'phrase' | 'disabled'\n\ttargets?: ( string | { column: string; weight: number } )[]\n\tvalueBooters?: Array\u003c{ column: string; value: string; factor: number }\u003e\n\tvectorColumn?: string\n\tvectorContentColumn?: string\n\tfilter?: Record\u003cstring, any\u003e\n} ): XataAskOptions =\u003e {\n\tconst options: XataAskOptions = {\n\t\trules: config.rules,\n\t\tsearchType: config.searchType || 'keyword'\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.searchType === 'keyword' || !config.searchType ) {\n\t\toptions.search = {}\n\n\t\tif ( typeof config.fuzziness === 'number' ) {\n\t\t\toptions.search.fuzziness = config.fuzziness\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( config.prefix ) {\n\t\t\toptions.search.prefix = config.prefix\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( config.targets ) {\n\t\t\toptions.search.target = config.targets\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( config.valueBooters ) {\n\t\t\toptions.search.boosters = config.valueBooters.map( booster =\u003e ( {\n\t\t\t\tvalueBooster: booster\n\t\t\t} ) )\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif ( config.filter ) {\n\t\t\toptions.search.filter = config.filter\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif ( config.searchType === 'vector' ) {\n\t\toptions.vectorSearch = {\n\t\t\tcolumn: config.vectorColumn || 'embedding',\n\t\t\tcontentColumn: config.vectorContentColumn,\n\t\t\tfilter: config.filter\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn options\n}",

The response streams JSON chunks prefixed with data:. The final event includes done, sessionId, and records.\n\nExample stream snippet:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\ndata: {\"text\":\"\"}\ndata: {\"text\":\"To\"}\ndata: {\"text\":\" perform\"}\n...\ndata: {\"done\":true,\"sessionId\":\"cg52bk1eqh5rd5hndhq95jercs\",\"records\":[\"0415d654cc8dd113e9b9423f425697ae\",\"91301cdc08524e6f6eef5d0b9d66e345\",\"ae0c68966fc0f00cb913b3c209a7c5a1\"]}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nNext.js SSE example: \u003chttps://github.com/xataio/examples/tree/main/apps/sample-chatgpt\u003e\n\n## Conversations and follow‑ups (sessions)\n\nEach conversation has a session that caches your rules and context.\n\nContinue a session:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;ts\nconst result = await xata.db.Tutorial.ask('\u003cyour follow-up message\u003e', {\n  sessionId: '\u003csession id\u003e'\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nXata ensures rules, context, and as many messages as allowed fit within the OpenAI limits, trimming older messages first if needed.\n\n## Examples\n\nSimplest usage (defaults to keyword search):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;ts\nconst result = await xata.db.Tutorial.ask('What is this tutorial about?');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nKeyword search with rules and relevancy tuning:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;ts\n",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: xata, database, db\nglobs: \nalwaysApply: false\n---\n# Xata Database Operations Guide\n\nThis guide provides a comprehensive reference for implementing CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on Xata database tables in the Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project.\n\n## Database Schema Overview\n\nRefer to [xata-schema.mdc](mdc:ultraterrestrial-resurrection/.cursor/rules/xata-schema.mdc)\n\nThe Xata database contains the following tables:\n\n### Core Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;topics&#96; | Information about UFO/UAP-related topics |\n| &#96;personnel&#96; | People involved in UFO/UAP cases (witnesses, experts, officials) |\n| &#96;events&#96; | UFO/UAP incidents and historical events |\n| &#96;organizations&#96; | Groups, agencies, and organizations |\n| &#96;sightings&#96; | UFO/UAP sighting reports |\n| &#96;testimonies&#96; | Witness statements and claims |\n| &#96;documents&#96; | Documentation, reports, and files |\n| &#96;artifacts&#96; | Physical evidence and artifacts |\n| &#96;locations&#96; | Physical locations related to UFO/UAP incidents |\n| &#96;key-figures&#96; | Key individuals in UFO/UAP research and history |\n| &#96;theories&#96; | Explanatory theories about UFO/UAP phenomena |\n| &#96;tags&#96; | Tags for categorizing content |\n| &#96;users&#96; | System users |\n| &#96;user-notes&#96; | User-created notes and theories |\n| &#96;mindmaps&#96; | User-created mind maps for connecting information |\n\n### Relationship Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;event-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Connects events to subject matter experts |\n| &#96;event-topic-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Links events, topics, and subject matter experts |\n| &#96;organization-members&#96; | Connects organizations to their members |\n| &#96;topic-subject-matter-experts&#96; | Links topics to subject matter experts |\n| &#96;topics-testimonies&#96; | Connects topics to testimonies |\n| &#96;summary-files&#96; | Links summaries to documents |\n\n### User Relationship Tables\n| Table | Description |\n|-------|-------------|\n| &#96;user-saved-documents&#96; | Documents saved by users |\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "### A. General Migration Strategy\n\n* **Primary Keys:** Xata uses string/char-based unique IDs like &#96;rec_abc123...&#96;. Maintain these as &#96;id&#96; (type: &#96;text&#96; or &#96;varchar&#96;) in Supabase to preserve all foreign key integrity and relationships.\n* **Foreign Keys:** Ensure that any &#96;link&#96; or relation columns point to the Xata-format char IDs, not integer autoincrements.\n* **Data Types:** Closest Postgres types are suggested below. Pay particular attention to:\n  * &#96;vector&#96;: Use &#96;vector&#96; extension or &#96;float[]&#96;.\n  * &#96;file&#96;, &#96;file[]&#96;: Use &#96;text[]&#96; or a Supabase Storage integration pattern.\n  * &#96;text&#96;, &#96;string&#96;: Use &#96;text&#96; or &#96;varchar&#96;.\n  * &#96;multiple&#96;: Use &#96;text[]&#96; or a dedicated join table if needed.\n  * &#96;json&#96;: Use &#96;jsonb&#96;.\n* **Empty Tables:** Some tables have no columns; just duplicate structure for now.\n* **Uniqueness:** Check/port all unique constraints, especially on &#96;title&#96;, &#96;email&#96;, etc.\n\n---\n\n### B. Tables to Create (Xata parity in Supabase)\n\n#### 1. topics\n\n* id (&#96;text&#96; primary key)\n* name (&#96;text&#96;)\n* summary (&#96;text&#96;)\n* photo (&#96;text&#96;) or (&#96;text[]&#96; if you want to future-proof)\n* photos (&#96;text[]&#96;)\n* title (&#96;text&#96;, unique)\n* embedding (&#96;vector(1536)&#96; or &#96;float[]&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [topic-subject-matter-experts], [topics-testimonies], [event-topic-subject-matter-experts], [user-saved-topics]\n\n#### 2. personnel\n\n* id (&#96;text&#96; primary key)\n* bio (&#96;text&#96;)\n* role (&#96;text&#96;)\n* photo (&#96;text[]&#96;)\n* rank, credibility, popularity, authority (&#96;integer&#96;)\n* name (&#96;text&#96;, unique)\n* embedding (&#96;vector(1536)&#96; or &#96;float[]&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [organization-members], [event-subject-matter-experts], etc.\n\n#### 3. events\n\n* id, name, description, location, latitude, longitude, date, photos, metadata, title (unique), summary, category (&#96;text[]&#96;), embedding (&#96;vector&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [event-subject-matter-experts], etc.\n\n#### 4. organizations\n\n* id, name, specialization, description, photo, image, title(unique), embedding (vector 500)\n* ⮩ links: [organization-members], etc.\n\n#### 5. sightings\n\n",

        "originalContents": "### A. General Migration Strategy\n\n* **Primary Keys:** Xata uses string/char-based unique IDs like &#96;rec_abc123...&#96;. Maintain these as &#96;id&#96; (type: &#96;text&#96; or &#96;varchar&#96;) in Supabase to preserve all foreign key integrity and relationships.\n* **Foreign Keys:** Ensure that any &#96;link&#96; or relation columns point to the Xata-format char IDs, not integer autoincrements.\n* **Data Types:** Closest Postgres types are suggested below. Pay particular attention to:\n  * &#96;vector&#96;: Use &#96;vector&#96; extension or &#96;float[]&#96;.\n  * &#96;file&#96;, &#96;file[]&#96;: Use &#96;text[]&#96; or a Supabase Storage integration pattern.\n  * &#96;text&#96;, &#96;string&#96;: Use &#96;text&#96; or &#96;varchar&#96;.\n  * &#96;multiple&#96;: Use &#96;text[]&#96; or a dedicated join table if needed.\n  * &#96;json&#96;: Use &#96;jsonb&#96;.\n* **Empty Tables:** Some tables have no columns; just duplicate structure for now.\n* **Uniqueness:** Check/port all unique constraints, especially on &#96;title&#96;, &#96;email&#96;, etc.\n\n---\n\n### B. Tables to Create (Xata parity in Supabase)\n\n#### 1. topics\n\n* id (&#96;text&#96; primary key)\n* name (&#96;text&#96;)\n* summary (&#96;text&#96;)\n* photo (&#96;text&#96;) or (&#96;text[]&#96; if you want to future-proof)\n* photos (&#96;text[]&#96;)\n* title (&#96;text&#96;, unique)\n* embedding (&#96;vector(1536)&#96; or &#96;float[]&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [topic-subject-matter-experts], [topics-testimonies], [event-topic-subject-matter-experts], [user-saved-topics]\n\n#### 2. personnel\n\n* id (&#96;text&#96; primary key)\n* bio (&#96;text&#96;)\n* role (&#96;text&#96;)\n* photo (&#96;text[]&#96;)\n* rank, credibility, popularity, authority (&#96;integer&#96;)\n* name (&#96;text&#96;, unique)\n* embedding (&#96;vector(1536)&#96; or &#96;float[]&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [organization-members], [event-subject-matter-experts], etc.\n\n#### 3. events\n\n* id, name, description, location, latitude, longitude, date, photos, metadata, title (unique), summary, category (&#96;text[]&#96;), embedding (&#96;vector&#96;)\n* ⮩ links: [event-subject-matter-experts], etc.\n\n#### 4. organizations\n\n* id, name, specialization, description, photo, image, title(unique), embedding (vector 500)\n* ⮩ links: [organization-members], etc.\n\n#### 5. sightings\n\n",

        "contents": "// ChatGPT 01-mini\nexport const DATABASE_SCHEMA_PROMPT_V3 = &#96;\nSystem Prompt: Web Research Agent Data Model\n\nThis system utilizes a structured relational database comprising multiple interconnected tables. Below is a detailed overview of each table, its fields, and its associations within the database schema.\n\n1. Topics\n\nPurpose: Stores information about various topics.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): The name of the topic.\n\t•\tsummary (text): A detailed summary of the topic.\n\t•\tphoto (file): A single photo representing the topic.\n\t•\tphotos (file[]): Multiple photos associated with the topic.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the topic.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\ttopic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\ttopics-testimonies: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-topics: Linked via the topic column.\n\n2. Personnel\n\nPurpose: Contains information about personnel involved in various capacities.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tbio (text): Biography of the personnel.\n\t•\trole (string): Role or position held.\n\t•\tfacebook (string): Facebook profile link.\n\t•\ttwitter (string): Twitter handle.\n\t•\twebsite (string): Personal or professional website.\n\t•\tinstagram (string): Instagram profile link.\n\t•\tphoto (file[]): Multiple photos of the personnel.\n\t•\trank (int): Rank or level.\n\t•\tcredibility (int): Credibility score.\n\t•\tpopularity (int): Popularity score.\n\t•\tname (string, unique): Full name of the personnel.\n\t•\tauthority (int): Authority score.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\torganization-members: Linked via the member column.\n\t•\tevent-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\ttopic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the witness column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-key-figure: Linked via the key-figure column.\n\t•\tdocuments: Linked via the author column.\n\n3. Events\n\nPurpose: Records details about various events.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (text): Name of the event.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Detailed description of the event.\n\t•\tlocation (string): Location of the event.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate of the event location.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate of the event location.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date and time of the event.\n\t•\tphotos (file[]): Photos from the event.\n\t•\tmetadata (json, default: “{}”): Additional metadata in JSON format.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the event.\n\t•\tsummary (text): Summary of the event.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tevent-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-events: Linked via the event column.\n\n4. Organizations\n\nPurpose: Maintains data about various organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): Name of the organization.\n\t•\tspecialization (string): Area of specialization.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Description of the organization.\n\t•\tphoto (text): Photo URL or identifier.\n\t•\timage (file, defaultPublicAccess: true): Image file with public access.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the organization.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\torganization-members: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-organizations: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\tdocuments: Linked via the organization column.\n\n5. Sightings\n\nPurpose: Logs sightings with detailed information.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the sighting.\n\t•\tdescription (string): Description of the sighting.\n\t•\tmedia_link (string): Link to media related to the sighting.\n\t•\tcity (string): City where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tstate (string): State where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tcountry (string): Country where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tshape (string): Shape observed during the sighting.\n\t•\tduration_seconds (string): Duration in seconds.\n\t•\tduration_hours_min (string): Duration in hours and minutes.\n\t•\tcomments (string): Additional comments.\n\t•\tdate_posted (datetime): Date the sighting was posted.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tuser-saved-sightings: Linked via the sighting column.\n\n6. Event-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Associates events with subject matter experts.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n7. Topic-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Links topics with subject matter experts.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n8. Organization-Members\n\nPurpose: Connects personnel members to organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tmember (link to Personnel): Reference to the personnel member.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the organization.\n\n9. Testimonies\n\nPurpose: Captures testimonies related to events and organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tclaim (text): The claim made in the testimony.\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\tsummary (text): Summary of the testimony.\n\t•\twitness (link to Personnel): Reference to the witness.\n\t•\tdocumentation (file[]): Supporting documentation files.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the testimony.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the related organization.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\ttopics-testimonies: Linked via the testimony column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-testimonies: Linked via the testimony column.\n\n10. Topics-Testimonies\n\nPurpose: Associates topics with testimonies.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\ttestimony (link to Testimonies): Reference to the testimony.\n\n11. Documents\n\nPurpose: Stores documents with associated metadata.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tfile (file[]): Document files.\n\t•\tcontent (text): Content of the document.\n\t•\tembedding (vector, dimension: 1536): Vector embedding for the document.\n\t•\ttitle (string): Title of the document.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the document.\n\t•\tauthor (link to Personnel): Reference to the author.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the organization.\n\t•\turl (text): URL link to the document.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tuser-saved-documents: Linked via the document column.\n\n12. Locations\n\nPurpose: Defines various geographical locations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): Name of the location.\n\t•\tcoordinates (string): Coordinate representation.\n\t•\tgoogle-maps-location-id (text): Google Maps Location ID.\n\t•\tcity (string): City of the location.\n\t•\tstate (string): State of the location.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate.\n\n13. Event-Topic-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Links events, topics, and subject matter experts together.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n14. Artifacts\n\nPurpose: Manages artifacts with detailed descriptions and media.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string, unique): Name of the artifact.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Description of the artifact.\n\t•\tphotos (multiple): Multiple photos of the artifact.\n\t•\tdate (string): Date associated with the artifact.\n\t•\tsource (text): Source of the artifact information.\n\t•\torigin (text): Origin details of the artifact.\n\t•\timages (file[], defaultPublicAccess: true): Image files with public access.\n\nNotes:\n\t•\tData Types:\n\t•\tstring: A short text field.\n\t•\ttext: A longer text field.\n\t•\tfile: A single file upload.\n\t•\tfile[]: Multiple file uploads.\n\t•\tint: Integer number.\n\t•\tfloat: Floating-point number.\n\t•\tdatetime: Date and time.\n\t•\tjson: JSON-formatted data.\n\t•\tvector: Numerical vector for embeddings.\n\t•\tlink: Reference to another table.\n\t•\tmultiple: Indicates multiple entries or files.\n\t•\tConstraints:\n\t•\tFields marked as unique must have distinct values across all records in the table.\n\t•\tdefaultValue specifies the default value if none is provided.\n\t•\tdefaultPublicAccess indicates that the file is publicly accessible by default.\n\t•\tRelationships:\n\t•\tDefined to establish connections between tables, enabling relational data queries.\n\t•\tEach relationship specifies the linking column and the target table.\n\nThis structured data model ensures organized storage and efficient retrieval of information, facilitating comprehensive web research operations.\n",

          },

        "originalContents": "// ChatGPT 01-mini\nexport const DATABASE_SCHEMA_PROMPT_V3 = &#96;\nSystem Prompt: Web Research Agent Data Model\n\nThis system utilizes a structured relational database comprising multiple interconnected tables. Each table is defined with specific columns, data types, constraints, and relationships to other tables. Below is a detailed overview of each table, its fields, and its associations within the database schema.\n\n1. Topics\n\nPurpose: Stores information about various topics.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): The name of the topic.\n\t•\tsummary (text): A detailed summary of the topic.\n\t•\tphoto (file): A single photo representing the topic.\n\t•\tphotos (file[]): Multiple photos associated with the topic.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the topic.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\ttopic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\ttopics-testimonies: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the topic column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-topics: Linked via the topic column.\n\n2. Personnel\n\nPurpose: Contains information about personnel involved in various capacities.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tbio (text): Biography of the personnel.\n\t•\trole (string): Role or position held.\n\t•\tfacebook (string): Facebook profile link.\n\t•\ttwitter (string): Twitter handle.\n\t•\twebsite (string): Personal or professional website.\n\t•\tinstagram (string): Instagram profile link.\n\t•\tphoto (file[]): Multiple photos of the personnel.\n\t•\trank (int): Rank or level.\n\t•\tcredibility (int): Credibility score.\n\t•\tpopularity (int): Popularity score.\n\t•\tname (string, unique): Full name of the personnel.\n\t•\tauthority (int): Authority score.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\torganization-members: Linked via the member column.\n\t•\tevent-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\ttopic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the witness column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the subject-matter-expert column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-key-figure: Linked via the key-figure column.\n\t•\tdocuments: Linked via the author column.\n\n3. Events\n\nPurpose: Records details about various events.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (text): Name of the event.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Detailed description of the event.\n\t•\tlocation (string): Location of the event.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate of the event location.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate of the event location.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date and time of the event.\n\t•\tphotos (file[]): Photos from the event.\n\t•\tmetadata (json, default: “{}”): Additional metadata in JSON format.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the event.\n\t•\tsummary (text): Summary of the event.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tevent-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\tevent-topic-subject-matter-experts: Linked via the event column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-events: Linked via the event column.\n\n4. Organizations\n\nPurpose: Maintains data about various organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): Name of the organization.\n\t•\tspecialization (string): Area of specialization.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Description of the organization.\n\t•\tphoto (text): Photo URL or identifier.\n\t•\timage (file, defaultPublicAccess: true): Image file with public access.\n\t•\ttitle (string, unique): A unique title for the organization.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\torganization-members: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\ttestimonies: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-organizations: Linked via the organization column.\n\t•\tdocuments: Linked via the organization column.\n\n5. Sightings\n\nPurpose: Logs sightings with detailed information.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the sighting.\n\t•\tdescription (string): Description of the sighting.\n\t•\tmedia_link (string): Link to media related to the sighting.\n\t•\tcity (string): City where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tstate (string): State where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tcountry (string): Country where the sighting occurred.\n\t•\tshape (string): Shape observed during the sighting.\n\t•\tduration_seconds (string): Duration in seconds.\n\t•\tduration_hours_min (string): Duration in hours and minutes.\n\t•\tcomments (string): Additional comments.\n\t•\tdate_posted (datetime): Date the sighting was posted.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tuser-saved-sightings: Linked via the sighting column.\n\n6. Event-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Associates events with subject matter experts.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n7. Topic-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Links topics with subject matter experts.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n8. Organization-Members\n\nPurpose: Connects personnel members to organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tmember (link to Personnel): Reference to the personnel member.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the organization.\n\n9. Testimonies\n\nPurpose: Captures testimonies related to events and organizations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tclaim (text): The claim made in the testimony.\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\tsummary (text): Summary of the testimony.\n\t•\twitness (link to Personnel): Reference to the witness.\n\t•\tdocumentation (file[]): Supporting documentation files.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the testimony.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the related organization.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\ttopics-testimonies: Linked via the testimony column.\n\t•\tuser-saved-testimonies: Linked via the testimony column.\n\n10. Topics-Testimonies\n\nPurpose: Associates topics with testimonies.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\ttestimony (link to Testimonies): Reference to the testimony.\n\n11. Documents\n\nPurpose: Stores documents with associated metadata.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tfile (file[]): Document files.\n\t•\tcontent (text): Content of the document.\n\t•\tembedding (vector, dimension: 1536): Vector embedding for the document.\n\t•\ttitle (string): Title of the document.\n\t•\tdate (datetime): Date of the document.\n\t•\tauthor (link to Personnel): Reference to the author.\n\t•\torganization (link to Organizations): Reference to the organization.\n\t•\turl (text): URL link to the document.\n\nRelationships:\n\t•\tuser-saved-documents: Linked via the document column.\n\n12. Locations\n\nPurpose: Defines various geographical locations.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string): Name of the location.\n\t•\tcoordinates (string): Coordinate representation.\n\t•\tgoogle-maps-location-id (text): Google Maps Location ID.\n\t•\tcity (string): City of the location.\n\t•\tstate (string): State of the location.\n\t•\tlatitude (float): Latitude coordinate.\n\t•\tlongitude (float): Longitude coordinate.\n\n13. Event-Topic-Subject-Matter-Experts\n\nPurpose: Links events, topics, and subject matter experts together.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tevent (link to Events): Reference to the related event.\n\t•\ttopic (link to Topics): Reference to the related topic.\n\t•\tsubject-matter-expert (link to Personnel): Reference to the subject matter expert.\n\n14. Artifacts\n\nPurpose: Manages artifacts with detailed descriptions and media.\n\nColumns:\n\t•\tname (string, unique): Name of the artifact.\n\t•\tdescription (text): Description of the artifact.\n\t•\tphotos (multiple): Multiple photos of the artifact.\n\t•\tdate (string): Date associated with the artifact.\n\t•\tsource (text): Source of the artifact information.\n\t•\torigin (text): Origin details of the artifact.\n\t•\timages (file[], defaultPublicAccess: true): Image files with public access.\n\nNotes:\n\t•\tData Types:\n\t•\tstring: A short text field.\n\t•\ttext: A longer text field.\n\t•\tfile: A single file upload.\n\t•\tfile[]: Multiple file uploads.\n\t•\tint: Integer number.\n\t•\tfloat: Floating-point number.\n\t•\tdatetime: Date and time.\n\t•\tjson: JSON-formatted data.\n\t•\tvector: Numerical vector for embeddings.\n\t•\tlink: Reference to another table.\n\t•\tmultiple: Indicates multiple entries or files.\n\t•\tConstraints:\n\t•\tFields marked as unique must have distinct values across all records in the table.\n\t•\tdefaultValue specifies the default value if none is provided.\n\t•\tdefaultPublicAccess indicates that the file is publicly accessible by default.\n\t•\tRelationships:\n\t•\tDefined to establish connections between tables, enabling relational data queries.\n\t•\tEach relationship specifies the linking column and the target table.\n\nThis structured data model ensures organized storage and efficient retrieval of information, facilitating comprehensive web research operations.\n",

// unique\n  summary: text;\n  photo: file;\n  photos: file[];\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Rev links: topic-subject-matter-experts, topics-testimonies, etc.\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;events&#96;** - UAP Incidents \u0026 Sightings\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Events {\n  name: string;\n  description: text;\n  date: datetime;\n  location: link\u003cLocations\u003e;\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  credibility_score: int;\n  // Complex relationships with personnel, organizations, testimonies\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;personnel&#96;** - Key Figures in UAP Research\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Personnel {\n  name: string;         "contents": "-- Clean and Seed Local PostgreSQL Database\n-- Date: July 25, 2025  \n-- Purpose: Clean existing tables and create proper schema matching Xata exports\n\n-- Enable vector extension\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;\n\n-- Drop ALL existing tables to start fresh\nDROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;\nCREATE SCHEMA public;\nGRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO liamellis;\nGRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO public;\n\n-- Recreate vector extension\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;\n\n-- Create tables matching Xata schema exactly\nCREATE TABLE topics (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT,\n    summary TEXT,\n    photo TEXT,\n    photos TEXT,\n    title TEXT UNIQUE,\n    embedding vector(1536),\n    xata_createdat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_updatedat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE personnel (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    bio TEXT,\n    role TEXT,\n    photo TEXT,\n    rank INTEGER,\n    credibility INTEGER,\n    popularity INTEGER,\n    name TEXT UNIQUE,\n    authority INTEGER,\n    embedding vector(1536),\n    xata_createdat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_updatedat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE events (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT,\n    description TEXT,\n    location TEXT,\n    latitude FLOAT,\n    longitude FLOAT,\n    date TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    photos TEXT,\n    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}',\n    title TEXT UNIQUE,\n    summary TEXT,\n    category TEXT,\n    embedding vector(1536),\n    xata_createdat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_updatedat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE organizations (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT,\n    specialization TEXT,\n    description TEXT,\n    photo TEXT,\n    image TEXT,\n    title TEXT UNIQUE,\n    embedding vector(500),\n    xata_createdat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_updatedat TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),\n    xata_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0\n);\n\n",

self.target_pg_url = \"postgresql://kgubvq:xau_T2uckroqht3tNd7pL3uETsxM0EC5WSNd1@us-east-1.sql.xata.sh/ultraterrestrial-postgres:main?sslmode=require\"\n        \n        # Paths\n print(f\"Source: {self.source_workspace}/{self.source_database}\")\n        print(f\"Target: {self.target_workspace}/{self.target_database}\")\n        print()\n\n    def run_export(self):\n        \"\"\"Export all data from current production instance using xreplay.py\"\"\"\n        print(\"📤 STEP 1: Exporting data from current production instance...\")\n        \n        # Ensure exports photos (file[], defaultPublicAccess: true)\n  - title (string, unique)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 1536)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - topic-subject-matter-experts (topic)\n  - topics-testimonies (topic)\n  - event-topic-subject-matter-experts (topic)\n  - user-saved-topics (topic)\n\n## personnel\n\n- **Columns:**\n  - bio (text)\n  - role (string)\n  - photo (file[])\n  - rank (int)\n  - credibility (int)\n  - popularity (int)\n  - name (string, unique)\n  - authority (int)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 1536)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - organization-members (member)\n  - event-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - topic-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - testimonies (witness)\n  - event-topic-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - user-saved-key-figure (key-figure)\n  - documents (author)\n\n## events\n\n- **Columns:**\n  - name (text)\n  - description (text)\n  - location (string)\n  - latitude (float)\n  - longitude (float)\n  - date (datetime)\n  - photos (file[])\n  - metadata (json, defaultValue: \"{}\")\n  - title (string, unique)\n  - summary (text)\n  - category (multiple)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 1536)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - event-subject-matter-experts (event)\n  - testimonies (event)\n  - event-topic-subject-matter-experts (event)\n  - user-saved-events (event)\n\n## organizations\n\n- **Columns:**\n  - name (string)\n  - specialization (string)\n  - description (text)\n  - photo (text)\n  - image (file, defaultPublicAccess: true)\n  - title (string, unique)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 500)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - organization-members (organization)\n  - testimonies (organization)\n  - user-saved-organizations (organization)\n  - documents (organization)\n\n## sightings\n\n",

@@ -1,1 +1,927 @@
- 
+ # Xata TypeScript SDK Developer Guide
+ 
+ **Version**: 1.0.0  
+ **Last Updated**: August 8, 2025  
+ **Package**: @db - Database abstraction layer for Ultraterrestrial Resurrection  
+ **Status**: ✅ **PRODUCTION READY** - Fully operational with advanced AI capabilities
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🎯 **Executive Summary**
+ 
+ The Ultraterrestrial Resurrection project features a sophisticated, production-ready Xata TypeScript SDK implementation that provides type-safe access to UFO/UAP research data through Xata PostgreSQL with advanced AI features including vector search, geospatial queries, and semantic relationships.
+ 
+ ### **Key Features**
+ 
+ - **Complete TypeScript Coverage**: Full type safety with generated schema types
+ - **Advanced AI Integration**: Ask Xata AI for intelligent question answering
+ - **Vector Search**: 1536-dimensional embeddings for semantic similarity
+ - **Comprehensive Schema**: 28+ tables covering complete UFO research domain
+ - **Performance Optimized**: Caching, connection pooling, and query optimization
+ - **Developer Experience**: Multiple import patterns and comprehensive error handling
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🚀 **Quick Start**
+ 
+ ### **Installation &amp; Setup**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install dependencies
+ npm install @db
+ 
+ # Or using the monorepo
+ cd packages/db
+ npm install
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Environment Configuration**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Required environment variables
+ XATA_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
+ XATA_DATABASE_URL=https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Basic Usage**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata/client';
+ 
+ // Simple query
+ const topics = await xata.db.topics.getAll();
+ 
+ // With filters
+ const highCredibilityPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel
+   .filter('credibility', 'gte', 8)
+   .getMany();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🏗️ **Architecture Overview**
+ 
+ ### **Package Structure**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ packages/db/
+ ├── index.ts                    # Main package exports
+ ├── registry.ts                 # Database provider registry
+ ├── src/
+ │   └── xata-typescript-sdk/   # Complete Xata integration
+ │       ├── client.ts          # Client instance &amp; configuration
+ │       ├── xata.ts            # Generated schema definitions
+ │       ├── models/            # Entity models (15+ files)
+ │       ├── api/               # Advanced API functions
+ │       └── types/             # TypeScript definitions
+ └── types/                     # Comprehensive type exports
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Core Components**
+ 
+ #### **1. Provider Registry System**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { PROVIDERS } from '@db/registry';
+ 
+ // Access any provider
+ const data = await PROVIDERS.xata.db.events.getAll();
+ 
+ // Provider selection
+ function getDataWithProvider(providerKey: 'xata') {
+   const provider = PROVIDERS[providerKey];
+   return provider.db.someTable.getAll();
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **2. Xata Client**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { getXataClient, xata } from '@db/xata';
+ 
+ // Singleton pattern
+ const client = getXataClient();
+ 
+ // Direct instance
+ const topics = await xata.db.topics.getAll();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 📊 **Database Schema**
+ 
+ ### **Primary Entities**
+ 
+ #### **&#96;topics&#96;** - Research Topics &amp; Categories
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ interface Topics {
+   name: string;
+   title: string; // unique
+   summary: text;
+   photo: file;
+   photos: file[];
+   embedding: vector[1536];
+   // Relationships: topic-subject-matter-experts, topics-testimonies, etc.
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **&#96;events&#96;** - UAP Incidents &amp; Sightings
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ interface Events {
+   name: string;
+   description: text;
+   date: datetime;
+   location: string;
+   latitude: float;
+   longitude: float;
+   embedding: vector[1536];
+   // Complex relationships with personnel, organizations, testimonies
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **&#96;personnel&#96;** - Key Figures in UAP Research
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ interface Personnel {
+   name: string; // unique
+   bio: text;
+   role: string;
+   rank: int;
+   credibility: int;
+   authority: int;
+   popularity: int;
+   photo: file[];
+   embedding: vector[1536];
+   // Relationships: organization-members, subject-matter-experts
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **&#96;organizations&#96;** - Government Agencies &amp; Research Groups
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ interface Organizations {
+   name: string;
+   title: string; // unique
+   specialization: string;
+   description: text;
+   photo: text;
+   image: file;
+   embedding: vector[500];
+   // Relationships: organization-members, testimonies, documents
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Relationship Tables**
+ 
+ The database uses sophisticated junction tables to model complex relationships:
+ 
+ - **&#96;event-subject-matter-experts&#96;**: Links events to subject matter experts
+ - **&#96;topic-subject-matter-experts&#96;**: Connects topics with experts
+ - **&#96;organization-members&#96;**: Maps personnel to organizations
+ - **&#96;event-topic-subject-matter-experts&#96;**: Three-way relationships
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🔍 **Core Operations**
+ 
+ ### **CRUD Operations**
+ 
+ #### **Create Records**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ 
+ // Single record
+ const newTopic = await xata.db.topics.create({
+   name: 'UFO Disclosure Timeline',
+   title: 'government-disclosure-timeline',
+   summary: 'Chronological overview of government UFO disclosure events...',
+   embedding: [/* 1536-dimensional vector */]
+ });
+ 
+ // Multiple records
+ const newPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel.createMany([
+   {
+     name: 'Dr. John Smith',
+     role: 'Research Scientist',
+     credibility: 9,
+     authority: 8
+   },
+   {
+     name: 'Jane Doe',
+     role: 'Investigator',
+     credibility: 7,
+     authority: 6
+   }
+ ]);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **Read Records**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Get all records
+ const allTopics = await xata.db.topics.getAll();
+ 
+ // Get single record
+ const topic = await xata.db.topics.getFirst({
+   filter: { title: 'government-disclosure-timeline' }
+ });
+ 
+ // Get with pagination
+ const paginatedEvents = await xata.db.events
+   .getPaginated({
+     pagination: { size: 20, offset: 0 }
+   });
+ 
+ // Get with filters
+ const highCredibilityPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel
+   .filter('credibility', 'gte', 8)
+   .filter('authority', 'gte', 7)
+   .getMany();
+ 
+ // Get with sorting
+ const sortedEvents = await xata.db.events
+   .sort('date', 'desc')
+   .getMany();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **Update Records**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Update single record
+ const updatedTopic = await xata.db.topics.update(
+   'rec_abc123...',
+   {
+     summary: 'Updated summary with new information...',
+     embedding: [/* new embedding vector */]
+   }
+ );
+ 
+ // Update multiple records
+ const updateResult = await xata.db.personnel.updateMany(
+   { credibility: { $lt: 5 } },
+   { credibility: 5 }
+ );
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **Delete Records**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Delete single record
+ await xata.db.topics.delete('rec_abc123...');
+ 
+ // Delete with filter
+ await xata.db.sightings.deleteMany({
+   date: { $lt: '2020-01-01' }
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Advanced Queries**
+ 
+ #### **Relationship Queries**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Get events with related personnel
+ const eventsWithExperts = await xata.db.events
+   .select(['*', 'event-subject-matter-experts.*', 'event-subject-matter-experts.subject-matter-expert.*'])
+   .getMany();
+ 
+ // Get topics with testimonies
+ const topicsWithTestimonies = await xata.db.topics
+   .select(['*', 'topics-testimonies.*', 'topics-testimonies.testimony.*'])
+   .getMany();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### **Aggregation Queries**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript

+ ## 📱 **Integration Patterns**
+ 
+ ### **Next.js Integration**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // app/api/events/route.ts
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ 
+ export async function GET(request: Request) {
+   try {
+     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
+     const category = searchParams.get('category');
+     
+     const events = await xata.db.events
+       .filter('category', 'contains', category)
+       .getMany();
+     
+     return NextResponse.json({ events });
+   } catch (error) {
+     return NextResponse.json(
+       { error: 'Failed to fetch events' },
+       { status: 500 }
+     );
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **React Components**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // components/EventList.tsx
+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import type { EventsRecord } from '@db/types';
+ 
+ export function EventList() {
+   const [events, setEvents] = useState&lt;EventsRecord[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     async function fetchEvents() {
+       try {
+         const result = await xata.db.events
+           .sort('date', 'desc')
+           .getMany();
+         setEvents(result);
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Failed to fetch events:', error);
+       } finally {
+         setLoading(false);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     fetchEvents();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   if (loading) return &lt;div&gt;Loading events...&lt;/div&gt;;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div&gt;
+       {events.map(event =&gt; (
+         &lt;div key={event.id}&gt;
+           &lt;h3&gt;{event.name}&lt;/h3&gt;
+           &lt;p&gt;{event.summary}&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Server Actions**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // app/actions/events.ts
+ 'use server';
+ 
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
+ 
+ export async function createEvent(formData: FormData) {
+   try {
+     const event = await xata.db.events.create({
+       name: formData.get('name') as string,
+       description: formData.get('description') as string,
+       date: new Date(formData.get('date') as string),
+       location: formData.get('location') as string
+     });
+ 
+     revalidatePath('/events');
+     return { success: true, event };
+   } catch (error) {
+     return { success: false, error: error.message };
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## ⚡ **Performance Optimization**
+ 
+ ### **Connection Management**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Use singleton pattern for production
+ import { getXataClient } from '@db/xata';
+ 
+ const client = getXataClient();
+ 
+ // For development/testing, you can create multiple instances
+ import { XataClient } from '@db/xata/xata';
+ const testClient = new XataClient({
+   databaseURL: 'test-database-url',
+   apiKey: 'test-api-key'
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Query Optimization**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Select only needed fields
+ const lightweightTopics = await xata.db.topics
+   .select(['id', 'name', 'title'])
+   .getMany();
+ 
+ // Use pagination for large datasets
+ const paginatedResults = await xata.db.events
+   .getPaginated({
+     pagination: { size: 50, offset: 0 }
+   });
+ 
+ // Leverage indexes
+ const indexedSearch = await xata.db.personnel
+   .filter('name', 'startsWith', 'Dr.')
+   .filter('credibility', 'gte', 8)
+   .getMany();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Caching Strategies**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Implement application-level caching
+ import { cache } from 'react';
+ 
+ export const getCachedTopics = cache(async () =&gt; {
+   return await xata.db.topics.getAll();
+ });
+ 
+ // Use Next.js revalidation
+ export const revalidate = 3600; // 1 hour
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🛠️ **Error Handling &amp; Validation**
+ 
+ ### **Comprehensive Error Handling**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ 
+ async function safeDatabaseOperation() {
+   try {
+     const result = await xata.db.events.getAll();
+     return { success: true, data: result };
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error.code === 'XATA_API_ERROR') {
+       console.error('Xata API error:', error.message);
+       return { success: false, error: 'Database service unavailable' };
+     }
+     
+     if (error.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
+       console.error('Validation error:', error.details);
+       return { success: false, error: 'Invalid data provided' };
+     }
+     
+     console.error('Unexpected error:', error);
+     return { success: false, error: 'An unexpected error occurred' };
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Input Validation**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const EventSchema = z.object({
+   name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
+   description: z.string().min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters'),
+   date: z.date(),
+   location: z.string().min(1, 'Location is required')
+ });
+ 
+ export async function createValidatedEvent(input: unknown) {
+   try {
+     const validatedData = EventSchema.parse(input);
+     
+     const event = await xata.db.events.create(validatedData);
+     return { success: true, event };
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return { success: false, error: 'Validation failed', details: error.errors };
+     }
+     
+     return { success: false, error: 'Failed to create event' };
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🔒 **Security Best Practices**
+ 
+ ### **Environment Variables**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # .env.local
+ XATA_API_KEY=xau_your_api_key_here
+ XATA_DATABASE_URL=https://workspace-id.region.xata.sh/db/database_name
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **API Key Management**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Never expose API keys in client-side code
+ // Use server-side operations for sensitive operations
+ 
+ // ✅ Good - Server-side only
+ export async function createEvent(data: EventData) {
+   'use server';
+   return await xata.db.events.create(data);
+ }
+ 
+ // ❌ Bad - Client-side exposure
+ const client = new XataClient({
+   apiKey: 'xau_exposed_key' // Never do this
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Input Sanitization**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { sanitizeInput } from '@/utils/sanitization';
+ 
+ export async function createSafeEvent(data: EventData) {
+   const sanitizedData = {
+     name: sanitizeInput(data.name),
+     description: sanitizeInput(data.description),
+     location: sanitizeInput(data.location)
+   };
+   
+   return await xata.db.events.create(sanitizedData);
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ---

+ ### **Integration Tests**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // tests/integration/events.test.ts
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterAll } from 'vitest';
+ 
+ describe('Events Integration', () =&gt; {
+   let testEventId: string;
+ 
+   beforeAll(async () =&gt; {
+     // Setup test data
+     const event = await xata.db.events.create(mockEvent);
+     testEventId = event.id;
+   });
+ 
+   afterAll(async () =&gt; {
+     // Cleanup test data
+     if (testEventId) {
+       await xata.db.events.delete(testEventId);
+     }
+   });
+ 
+   it('should create and retrieve events', async () =&gt; {
+     const event = await xata.db.events.getFirst({
+       filter: { id: testEventId }
+     });
+     
+     expect(event).toBeDefined();
+     expect(event?.name).toBe(mockEvent.name);
+   });
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;

+ ### **Health Checks**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // app/api/health/route.ts
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ 
+ export async function GET() {
+   try {
+     // Test database connection
+     await xata.db.topics.getFirst();
+     
+     return NextResponse.json({
+       status: 'healthy',
+       database: 'connected',
+       timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+     });
+   } catch (error) {
+     return NextResponse.json(
+       {
+         status: 'unhealthy',
+         database: 'disconnected',
+         error: error.message,
+         timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+       },
+       { status: 503 }
+     );
+   }
+ }

+ ### **Monitoring &amp; Logging**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // lib/monitoring.ts
+ export async function logDatabaseOperation(
+   operation: string,
+   table: string,
+   duration: number,
+   success: boolean
+ ) {
+   console.log(&#96;[DB] ${operation} on ${table}: ${duration}ms - ${success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILED'}&#96;);
+   
+   // Send to monitoring service
+   if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
+     await sendMetrics({
+       operation,
+       table,
+       duration,
+       success
+     });
+   }
+ }

+ # Xata TypeScript SDK Code Examples
+ 
+ **Version**: 1.0.0  
+ **Last Updated**: August 8, 2025  
+ **Package**: @db - Database abstraction layer for Ultraterrestrial Resurrection
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ ## 🚀 **Quick Start Examples**
+ 
+ ### **Basic Client Setup**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata/client';
+ 
+ // Simple query
+ const topics = await xata.db.topics.getAll();
+ 
+ // With filters
+ const highCredibilityPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel
+   .filter('credibility', 'gte', 8)
+   .getMany();
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Provider Registry Usage**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { PROVIDERS } from '@db/registry';
+ 
+ // Access any provider
+ const data = await PROVIDERS.xata.db.events.getAll();
+ 
+ // Provider selection
+ function getDataWithProvider(providerKey: 'xata') {
+   const provider = PROVIDERS[providerKey];
+   return provider.db.someTable.getAll();
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;

+   embedding: [/* 1536-dimensional vector */]

+ 
+ // Multiple records

+     name: 'Dr. John Smith',

+ ## 🤖 **Ask Xata AI Examples**

+ ### **Basic AI Questions**

+ ### **Next.js API Routes**

+ // app/api/events/route.ts
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ 
+ export async function GET(request: Request) {
+   try {
+     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
+     const category = searchParams.get('category');
+     
+     const events = await xata.db.events
+       .filter('category', 'contains', category)
+       .getMany();
+     
+     return NextResponse.json({ events });
+   } catch (error) {

+ ### **React Components**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // components/EventList.tsx
+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import type { EventsRecord } from '@db/types';
+ 
+ export function EventList() {
+   const [events, setEvents] = useState&lt;EventsRecord[]&gt;([]);
+   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     async function fetchEvents() {
+       try {
+         const result = await xata.db.events
+           .sort('date', 'desc')
+           .getMany();
+         setEvents(result);
+       } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Failed to fetch events:', error);
+       } finally {
+         setLoading(false);
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     fetchEvents();
+   }, []);
+ 
+   if (loading) return &lt;div&gt;Loading events...&lt;/div&gt;;
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div&gt;
+       {events.map(event =&gt; (
+         &lt;div key={event.id}&gt;
+           &lt;h3&gt;{event.name}&lt;/h3&gt;
+           &lt;p&gt;{event.summary}&lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ))}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }

+ 'use server';
+ 
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
+ 
+ export async function createEvent(formData: FormData) {
+   try {
+     const event = await xata.db.events.create({
+       name: formData.get('name') as string,
+       description: formData.get('description') as string,
+       date: new Date(formData.get('date') as string),
+       location: formData.get('location') as string
+     });
+ 
+     revalidatePath('/events');
+     return { success: true, event };
+   } catch (error) {
+     return { success: false, error: error.message };
+   }
+ }

+ ## 🛠️ **Error Handling Examples**
+ 
+ ### **Comprehensive Error Handling**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { xata } from '@db/xata';
+ 
+ async function safeDatabaseOperation() {
+   try {
+     const result = await xata.db.events.getAll();
+     return { success: true, data: result };
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error.code === 'XATA_API_ERROR') {
+       console.error('Xata API error:', error.message);
+       return { success: false, error: 'Database service unavailable' };
+     }
+     
+     if (error.code === 'VALIDATION_ERROR') {
+       console.error('Validation error:', error.details);
+       return { success: false, error: 'Invalid data provided' };
+     }
+     
+     console.error('Unexpected error:', error);
+     return { success: false, error: 'An unexpected error occurred' };
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### **Input Validation**
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { z } from 'zod';
+ 
+ const EventSchema = z.object({
+   name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),
+   description: z.string().min(10, 'Description must be at least 10 characters'),
+   date: z.date(),
+   location: z.string().min(1, 'Location is required')
+ });
+ 
+ export async function createValidatedEvent(input: unknown) {
+   try {
+     const validatedData = EventSchema.parse(input);
+     
+     const event = await xata.db.events.create(validatedData);
+     return { success: true, event };
+   } catch (error) {
+     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
+       return { success: false, error: 'Validation failed', details: error.errors };
+     }
+     
+     return { success: false, error: 'Failed to create event' };
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
